name: List Invoices
description: Lists information from invoices in the given tenant id as per filter parameters.

configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: modifiedAfter
configurable_props.label: Modified After
configurable_props.description:
The ModifiedAfter filter is actually an HTTP header: **'If-Modified-Since'.**
A UTC timestamp (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss). Only invoices created or modified since this timestamp will be returned e.g. 2009-11-12T00:00:00

configurable_props.name: ids
configurable_props.label: IDs
configurable_props.description: Filter by a comma-separated list of InvoicesIDs. See [details](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/invoices#optimised-queryparameters).

configurable_props.name: invoiceNumbers
configurable_props.label: Invoice Numbers
configurable_props.description: Filter by a comma-separated list of InvoiceNumbers. See [details](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/invoices#optimised-queryparameters).

configurable_props.name: contactIds
configurable_props.label: Contact IDs
configurable_props.description: Filter by an array of ContactIDs. See [details](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/invoices#optimised-queryparameters).

configurable_props.name: statuses
configurable_props.label: Statuses
configurable_props.description: Filter by a comma-separated list of Statuses. See [details](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/invoices#optimised-queryparameters).

configurable_props.name: where
configurable_props.label: Where
configurable_props.description: Filter using the *where* parameter. We recommend you limit filtering to the [optimised elements](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/invoices#optimised-parameters) only.

configurable_props.name: createdByMyApp
configurable_props.label: Created By My App
configurable_props.description: When set to true you'll only retrieve Invoices created by your app.

configurable_props.name: order
configurable_props.label: Order
configurable_props.description: Order by any element returned ( see [Order By](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/requests-and-responses#ordering) ).

configurable_props.name: page
configurable_props.label: Page
configurable_props.description: Up to 100 invoices will be returned per call, with line items shown for each, when the page parameter is used e.g. page=1
